A growing course book for asking good questions, choosing useful representations, and supporting conclusions with evidence. Read the explanations, explore an activity, and check your reasoning against worked solutions.

## How to study with this book

Read an explanation, predict what will happen, and then use the activity. For construction questions, draw on paper before opening **Show solution**. A correct answer includes appropriate labels, a sensible scale, and reasoning in context—not only arithmetic.

[Sources and study resources](resources.qmd)
